title: TIAO: Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization for Text Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2609.16748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text summarization requires models to condense content while preserving key qualities such as consistency and coherence. Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on this task and can be further improved through reinforcement learning (RL). However, most existing methods apply reward signals directly to undifferentiated token sequences, overlooking the varying importance of individual tokens to word and sentence level quality in summarization. In this paper, we propose Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization (TIAO), a novel reinforcement learning strategy that explicitly leverages token-importance awareness. Specifically, TIAO identifies core tokens based on token dependency and reweights a trajectory's advantage according to its overall dependencies. translated_title: TIAO：面向文本摘要的词元重要性感知策略优化
translated_abstract: 文本摘要要求模型在压缩内容的同时保持一致性、连贯性等关键质量。大语言模型（LLMs）在这一任务上表现出色，并可通过强化学习（RL）进一步提升。然而，现有的大多数方法将奖励信号直接应用于无差别的词元序列，忽视了单个词元对摘要中词级和句级质量的差异化重要性。本文提出了词元重要性感知策略优化（TIAO），这是一种显式利用词元重要性感知的新型强化学习策略。具体而言，TIAO 基于词元依赖关系识别核心词元，并根据轨迹的整体依赖关系对其优势进行重新加权。在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，我们的 TIAO 取得了极具竞争力的结果，且经 TIAO 增强的 7B 基础模型的表现可与 GPT-（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出词元重要性感知策略优化方法TIAO，通过基于词元依赖关系识别核心词元并重新加权轨迹优势，使7B模型在文本摘要任务上达到与GPT相当的水平。
en_tdlr: TIAO introduces token importance-aware policy optimization that identifies core tokens via token dependency and reweights trajectory advantages accordingly, enabling a 7B model to achieve GPT-comparable performance in text summarization.
